ConformalRegion.description:
Split-conformal displacement radius per target time (build plan §5 U1). Marginal coverage
claim: over forecasts exchangeable with the stratum's calibration samples, at least
`nominal_level` of true positions fall within `radii_m[i]` of the forecast point. It is not a
probability for this particular ship, and it assumes exchangeability (measured empirical
coverage on the held-out test is in docs/benchmarks.md). Radii exist only at fitted
horizons; other target times are null (never interpolated).

Fractions of the cell's paired samples whose forecast, anywhere up to this horizon,
has the flag (evaluation.feasibility). Land rates are null when no land mask was loaded.

truth_on_land_rate.description: Same for every model: paired samples whose TRUE positions, at any evaluable step up to the horizon, the mask puts on land (cumulative, like the model rates). Vessels are not on land, so this is the mask's own error (docks, narrow channels): how much a land rate can be trusted

ForecastEvaluation.description:
Truth and errors for one forecast; returned separately and only on request.

Every target time is reported for every model (no silent drops). A target time without
truth is not evaluable for any model, with the truth reason; where truth exists but a model
produced no forecast, that model's score is `model_failed`. `paired` marks the target times
where every model is evaluable, the set to compare models on.

feasibility_mask.title: Feasibility Mask

paired.title: Paired

truth.title: Truth

truth_reasons.description: Per target time: why truth is missing; null where truth exists
truth_reasons.title: Truth Reasons

post.description: Start an unattended paired benchmark in a background process; poll its status.

get.description: Status, and once finalized the full immutable run record (checksums verified).

Failure gallery: one cell's paired samples for a model, worst first, by its error or
by its loss to the cell's best baseline (error minus the baseline's, same sample).

Per-sample records of a held-out test run are refused: every look at them belongs in
the test-access ledger, which only the CLI writes. Their aggregates stay readable.

Model x horizon x stratum table: medians with CIs and skill, side by side per
paired cell.

post.description:
Withheld truth and per-target-time errors for the forecast this request produces.

The forecast is the one `POST /forecasts` serves (same `forecast_id`); truth is read
only after it is made, from the truth region, never bridged across gaps.
